surface._doc: Local-processing attestation: the surface is the in-process HF transformers adapter (no third-party inference API, no retaining/logging surface); corpus-derived prompts are only ever submitted to this in-process surface, locally or inside the owner's gate job.

corpus._doc: Protected-corpus shards, mounted read-only; data-access contract: environment paths only, nothing copied into any repo.

verbatim._doc: Floor fixed by the underlying license agreement; only tighten.

mia._doc: Method of record: reference-calibrated loss difference (LiRA-style) on a MATCHED SPLIT. The matched split draws BOTH membership sets from the SAME train-shard chunk population — holdout_globs names the disjoint shard subset that forms held-out; the held-out sample's word-count distribution is matched to held-in via decile quantile bands, with a never-empty fallback to the full held-out population below the floor. A cross-collection split (held-in from train shards vs held-out from a different collection) measures collection difference, not membership — see docs/case-study.md for the falsification audit that derived this construction. Reference self control must sit at chance (0.5) or the probe FAILs as broken. Escalation clause: non-chance on a matched split with a domain-matched reference is genuine incremental memorization -> stop + escalate.

params.arch_note: DOMAIN-MATCHED reference: the candidate's own pre-adaptation base checkpoint — same tokenizer, same eval config, verified never trained on the protected corpus. Isolates corpus-specific memorization beyond legitimate lineage training

extraction._doc: Defaults ship generic + corpus-prefix templates; add synthetic canaries if the training run embedded any.

wordnet._doc: Reference-resource synset file (JSONL: id, pos, gloss, example, lemma[, relations]); vocab scan is the authoritative check, embedding sub-probe off.
